title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 20 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 20 February 2026 Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Eastern, Uva and Central provinces. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in Eastern province and in Matale, Badulla, Mullaitivu and Polonnaruwa districts. Several spells of showers may occur in Hambantota district. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Rathnapura, Galle, Matara and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower
